name: Extra Psychic Esoterica
body:
Your psychic power combined in new ways with your physical prowess.

Prerequisite(s): Psychic esoterica class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional psychic esoterica. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this esoterica.

Special: You can gain Extra Psychic Esoterica multiple times.
